CTI-0001 File Hash (SHA-256): Payload ransomware (Babuk-derived, double extortion) – Windows encryptor
objects.description: Three sources: Nopal/Derp.ca, MalwareBazaar signature Payload, VT 58/71 named babuk_payload_win; sandbox shows vssadmin shadow deletion, mutex and payload.log.

objects.name: CTI-0002 Mutex: Payload ransomware (Babuk-derived, double extortion)
objects.description: Listed by Nopal; created by validated sample in multiple VT sandboxes (\Sessions\1\BaseNamedObjects). Not logged by Defender, so YARA/live response only.

objects.name: CTI-0003 File Path: Payload ransomware (Babuk-derived, double extortion)
objects.description: Listed by Nopal; VT sandbox shows the --background child process writing C:\payload.log, linking log, relaunch and mutex.
